ammo.name: 7.62x25mm TT PBS gzh
ammo.description: A 7.62x25mm TT cartridge fitted with a modern 5 gram steel core bullet with a bimetallic jacket. This version changes the powder from the old soviet stuff to Hodgdon H110, the same used in big bore revolvers. As a result, its velocity increased dramatically, as did the durability burn however. Thanks to the lighter projectile, recoil increase was marginal. The larger steel core allows for better penetration, with only a little less terminal damage.

ammoBox.name: Box of 7.62x25mm TT PBS gzh
ammoBox.description: An ammo box of 50 7.62x25mm TT PBS gzh rounds.

ammo.name: 9x18mm PM PBP gzh
ammo.description: A 79x18mm TT cartridge fitted with a modern 3.2 gram steel core bullet with a bimetallic jacket. This version changes the powder from the old soviet stuff to Hodgdon H110, the same used in big bore revolvers. As a result, its velocity increased dramatically, as did the durability burn however. Thanks to the lighter projectile, recoil increase was marginal. The larger steel core allows for better penetration, with only a little less terminal damage.

ammoBox.name: 9x18mm PM PBP gzh
ammoBox.description: An ammo box of 9x18mm PM PBP gzh.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Steel 0 buckshot
ammo.description: A 12/70 shell loaded with 12 steel 0 buckshot pellets for 12 gauge shotguns. The smaller diameter of the pellets allow more to fit in each shell. Additionally, H110 powder was used to increase muzzle velocity. Steel pellets also allow for more penetration and occasionally results in fragmentation upon impact with bone.

ammo.name: 9x21mm 7N49 UZ Zubilo
ammo.description: 9x21mm 7N49 UZ Zubilo is a standard 7N42 projectile with an enhanced charge. Intended for more modern firearms, the higher chamber pressure enables both higher velocities and penetration. It also results in higher chances of fragmentation due to the higher speed resulting in more hydrostatic pressure. Durability burn is increased, although recoil only marginally increases in comparison.

ammoBox.name: Box of 9x21mm 7N49 UZ Zubilo
ammoBox.description: A box of 30 9x21mm 7N49 UZ Zubilo rounds.

ammo.name: 12/70 AP-21 Fragmenting AP Slug
ammo.description: The 12/70 AP-21 Fragmenting AP Slug is a side grade to the classic AP-21 slug. A steel slug is modified to the same shape as the AP-20 slug, but with softer and more available steel. Additional gunpowder is added, along side custom cuts made to the tip of the projectile creating more temporary and permanent wound cavity. The added speed, cuts, and turbulence increase fragmentation chance and bleeding upon impact. Penetration is noticeably less than AP-20, but damage and terminal effects are noticeably more.

ammo.name: .50 BMG Frangible HP
ammo.description: This specially designed frangible ammunition was created for a US Federal agency, but ultimately not adopted. It was later adapted for the civilian market. Its ability to dump all of its kinetic energy inside a single 16 inch block of standard ballistics gelatin made it useful for ranges to reduce target destruction and chance of injury to nearby properties and people. The Copper and Tin composite alongside a polymer insert allows for similar flight to ball ammunition, with vastly reduced penetration. The result is a bullet that immediately disintegrates upon impact with objects or flesh. The round also features reduced recoil and barrel wear due to a lighter overall bullet of 650 grains.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Power-Shok 00 Buckshot 12 Pellet
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok 00 Buckshot 12 Pellet is a modern version of the Magnum shotgun shell. Modern slow burn powder and better packaging of the wad and shot make for a much easier shell to utilize in combat. The extra Pellets compared to the standard Magnum means more overall damage. The velocity is slightly lower, meaning each individual pellet does less damage, but having more of them easily makes up for it. Recoil is reduced, but still substantial.

ammoBox.name: 12/70 12 Pellet 00 buckshot
ammoBox.description: A box of 12/70 12 Pellet 00 buckshot shotgun shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Power-Shok 000 Buckshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 8 Pellet 000 buckshot is a modern version of the Magnum shotgun shell with 000 pellets instead of the 00 in the standard Magnum shell. Modern slow burn powder and better packaging of the wad allow the same number of larger pellets to fit inside the same size shell. Recoil is also significantly reduced, relying on shot weight to do the damage instead of velocity. Each pellet is 9.1mm around and weighs 70 grains (4.54 Grams). The extra mass enhances barrier penetration, blunt force damage, and overall terminal effects. In many ways it is a straight upgrade to Magnum buckshot, however it does struggle at distance due to the lower velocity.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 000 Buckshot
ammoBox.description: A box of 12/70 000 buckshot Shotgun Shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 TSS AP Wrecking Ball Slug
ammo.description: The 12/70 TSS AP Wrecking Ball Slug is a hybrid Tungsten Alloy 630 grain slug aimed at defeating all soft body armor and defeating barriers. Fired at 427 m/s, this 41 gram projectile eats all but the strongest body armors. Its design also allows it to maintain accuracy at range, and its high density 1.8 times that of lead leads to a high ballistic coefficient for a 12 gauge slug. Upon impact, it will barely deform if at all. Due to the weight and speed, recoil is substantial with over 2,700 ft/lbs of muzzle energy. Extremely rare, extremely expensive, extremely effective.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 TSS AP Wrecking Ball Slugs
ammoBox.description: A box of 25 12/70 TSS AP Wrecking Ball Slug shotgun shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 TSS AP 00 Buckshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 TSS AP 00 buckshot is a Tungsten Alloy 6 pellet shotgun shell aimed at defeating soft body armor and defeating barriers. Fired at 372 m/s, this 6 pellet shell is highly effective against light and medium armor. Its design also allows it to maintain better accuracy at range. Tungsten's high density at 1.8 times that of lead leads to better velocity and pattern retention over distance. Upon impact, it will barely deform if at all. Extremely rare, extremely expensive, extremely effective.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 TSS AP 00 Buckshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of12/70 TSS AP 00 Buckshot shotgun Shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok Steel BB Birdshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok Steel BB Birdshot shotgun shells are primarily used for hunting water fowl to get around environmental regulations surrounding lead pollution. However, they have some combat usage, namely in slightly better penetration and devastating and painful effects on target. Unlike shells with much larger pellets, the small size of the steel BBs mean that 90 pellets fit in each shell. Steel deforms less, and while lighter than lead, holds up better on impact. The result of such a large number of pellets is extremely high bleed chances, and tremendous pain upon impact. Some say this might even be a warcrime...

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Hevi Steel BB Birdshot
ammoBox.description: A box of 12/70 Hevi Steel BB Birdshot shotgun Shells.

ammo.name: .50 BMG MK 211 Raufoss HEIAP
ammo.description: The .50 BMG MK 211 Raufoss HEIAP cartridge is a complex hybrid High explosive incendiary armor-piercing round. This round combines a tungsten carbide penetrator with an incendiary tip and a high explosive charge inside. The penetrator allows up to 11mm of steel penetration at 1000 meters at a 45 degree angle. Leaving the barrel at 2,950 fps with a 665 grain projectile, this round has enormous muzzle energy and penetration.

ammo.name: 12/70 Makeshift APEx .50 BMG slug
ammo.description: The 12/70 Makeshift HEIAP .50 BMG slug is the projectile from a Mk 211 .50 BMG cartridge, shoved into the shell of a 12 gauge shotgun. While the penetration of this version of the makeshift shell is better, the bulk of the advantages comes from the incendiary explosive payload delivered to the target.

ammoBox.name: 12/70 Makeshift APEx .50 BMG slug
ammoBox.description: A box of 12/70 Makeshift APEx .50 BMG slug shotgun shells.

ammo.name: .366 TKM AP-ME
ammo.description:
The .366 TKM AP-ME cartridge is an evolution of the AP-M cartridge. Mechanic designed this ammunition with the intention of limiting the numerous downsides of AP-M while still maintaining its useful features.
The solution was to utilize different powder and change the projectile from the SP-6 9x39 cartridge, to its better and lighter BP GS. While certainly more expensive, the result is a lower recoiling and more accurate round that maintains the penetration and most of the damage of the original round.

ammoBox.name: .366 TKM AP-ME
ammoBox.description: A box of 20 .366 TKM AP-ME rounds.

ammo.name: 4.6x30mm AP GX
ammo.description: The 4.6x30mm AP GX cartridge is an evolution of the AP SX cartridge based upon battle records and experience. The AP SX cartridge, while excellent in armor penetration, lacked the terminal effect needed to quickly dispatch threats. The addition of a quarter gram tungsten weight at the rear of the projectile resulted in two major changes. The first is added mass for greater terminal effect, though this did slow the speed down somewhat. Second, the change in center of mass of the projectile allowed for stable flight, but tumbled and fragmented almost immediately upon impact with a soft target. It maintained the majority of the penetration power of the AP SX round, but with enhanced damage.

ammoBox.name: Box of 4.6x30mm AP GX
ammoBox.description: A Box of 4.6x30mm AP GX rounds.

ammo.name: 5.7x28mm SS90 Prototype
ammo.description:
The 5.7x28mm SS90 Cartridge was the originally developed cartridge for the 5.7 and P90 program with HK. The tiny 1.5 gram projectile featured a polymer core that enabled it to reach speeds of 850 m/s at the muzzle. However its very small size and oddly long body made terminal effects limited, and penetration was deemed unsatisfactory. It was eventually replaced in 1993 with the heavier SS190 with a steel penetrator.
Wait where the hell did you find this? This was a military prototype in Germany discontinued in 1993?

ammoBox.name: Box of 5.7x28mm SS90 Prototype
ammoBox.description: A Box of 5.7x28mm SS90 Prototype rounds. Where are these from?

ammo.name: 5.7x28mm SS190 X Prototype
ammo.description: The 5.7x28mm SS190 X Prototype cartridge was developed alongside the 4.6 AP SX. The main difference is a half gram tungsten penetrator tip added and attached to the steel core of the SS190. The result is a slightly more penetrating cartridge and decent terminal effect despite minimal deformation.

ammoBox.name: Box of 5.7x28mm SS190 X Prototype
ammoBox.description: A Box of 5.7x28mm SS190 X Prototype rounds. These seem rare, no?

ammo.name: .357 Magnum Xtreme Penetrator
ammo.description: The .357 Magnum Copper Penetrator cartridge was developed to combat bears and other dangerous animals both for sport and protection while in the woods. The result is an oddly shaped almost screwdriver like projectile that has incredible penetration of both soft targets and barriers. The odd shape creates cavities and can even result in tumbling when disturbed from the penetration path by hard objects (bone). Expensive, but certainly effective.

ammoBox.name: Box of .357 Magnum Copper Penetrator
ammoBox.description: A Box of .357 Magnum Copper Penetrator rounds.

ammo.name: .50 AE Frangible HP
ammo.description: The .50 AE Frangible HP cartridge is a higher velocity round for the .50 AE caliber. It features a hybrid Copper-Tin cut hollow point with a lead base. The round is designed to instantly disintegrate upon impact and impart as much of its energy as possible in as short a distance as possible. The result is a devastating short range low penetration round. Against unarmored or very lightly armored target, one shot is usually effective. Its lighter weight projectile also means less recoil and less barrel wear.

ammoBox.name: Box of .50 AE Frangible HP
ammoBox.description: A Box of .50 AE Frangible HP rounds. These look like they would hurt!

ammo.name: .50 AE Copper Xtreme Penetrator
ammo.description: The .50 AE Copper Xtreme Penetrator cartridge is a slightly different version of the Copper Solid round. This version features a screwdriver like projectile that enhances penetration and creates additional wound cavity through hydrostatic shock. Penetration increase is marginal, but noticeble.

ammoBox.name: Box of .50 AE Copper Xtreme Penetrator
ammoBox.description: A Box of .50 AE Copper Xtreme Penetrator rounds.

ammo.name: .300 Blackout Punisher Subsonic
ammo.description: The .300 Blackout Punisher Subsonic manufactured by Gorilla Ammunition is a devastating personal protection ammunition. Its multipiece copper construction was developed to fragment immediately upon impact and propel three copper leaves and the main base deep into tissue. It is also subsonic out of a 16 inch barrel. These also have reduced recoil and the lower powder charge helps prevent overheating, though the solid copper does wear the barrel down faster.

ammoBox.name: Box of .300 Blackout Punisher Subsonic
ammoBox.description: A Box of .300 Blackout Punisher Subsonic rounds.

ammo.name: 6.8x51mm SIG Brass Hunting
ammo.description: The 6.8x51mm SIG Spearpoint is one of the many civilian commercial rounds available for purchase. The polymer and lead nose allows for excellent hunting and target practice performance, and the lower pressure preserves gun and barrel longevity. Pleasant to shoot, and relatively cheap, at least for 6.8.

ammoBox.name: Box of 6.8x51mm SIG Brass Hunting
ammoBox.description: A Box of 6.8x51mm SIG Brass Hunting rounds.

ammo.name: 6.8x51mm SIG Hollowpoint
ammo.description: The 6.8x51mm SIG Hollowpoint cartridge is as simple and cheap cartridge for plinking and hunting. Round to round variation is less controlled than other Sig ammo. However, recoil is light and the terminal effects of a hollow point moving at over 2,700 fps (840 m/s) cannot be undersold.

ammoBox.name: Box of 6.8x51mm SIG Hollowpoint
ammoBox.description: A Box of 6.8x51mm SIG Hollowpoint rounds.

ammo.name: 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid Black Tip
ammo.description: The 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid Black Tip cartridge uses the technology from M993 and similar armor piercing projectiles to enhance the already impressive penetration of the 6.8 cartridge. This Black Tip version contains a penetrator core, tungsten tip, and additional pressure increases to absolutely maximize the caliber. There is no better round for the SPEAR system.

ammoBox.name: Box of 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid Black Tip
ammoBox.description: A Box of 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid Black Tip rounds.

ammo.name: 23x75mm Lead Slug
ammo.description: The 23x75mm Lead Slug is a civilian creation for hunting and sport. Featuring a huge 875 grain lead hollowpoint slug, this shell is the definition of stopping power. Tough on the gun though. Also monstrous recoil.

ammoBox.name: Box of 23x75mm Lead Slug
ammoBox.description: A Box of 23x75mm Lead Slug shells.

ammo.name: 23x75mm "Shrapnel-5" Buckshot
ammo.description: The 23x75mm Shrapnel-5 Buckshot Shell is another civilian creation. Civilians took a KS-23 shell and put #4 buckshot in it. 54 pellets of #4 buck is enough to ruin anybody's day!

ammoBox.name: Box of 23x75mm "Shrapnel-5" Buckshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of 23x75mm "Shrapnel-5" Buckshot shells.

ammo.name: 23x75mm Birdshot
ammo.description: The 23x75mm Birdshot Shell is another civilian creation. Adding BB size birdshot to a KS-23 shell certainly is an idea of all time.

ammoBox.name: Box of 23x75mm Birdshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of 23x75mm Birdshot shells.

ammo.name: 9x21mm FR gzh
ammo.description: The 9x21mm FR gzh cartridge is a a bimetallic frangible Copper-Tin cut hollow point with a lead base. The round is designed to instantly disintegrate upon impact and impart as much of its energy as possible in as short a distance as possible. As a result, it creates debilitating wound channels on soft targets.

ammoBox.name: Box of 9x21mm FR gzh
ammoBox.description: A Box of 9x21mm FR gzh rounds.

ammo.name: 4.6x30mm FRANG SX
ammo.description: The 4.6x30mm FRANG SX cartridge is a copper-tin frangible round developed as a response to the R37 F round in 5.6x28. The round is designed to dump all of its energy upon impact with the target. This round has extremely low penetration, but remarkable soft target destruction.

ammoBox.name: Box of 4.6x30mm FRANG SX
ammoBox.description: A Box of 4.6x30mm FRANG SX rounds.

ammo.name: 40x46mm M576-T (MP-APERS-T)
ammo.description: The 40x46mm M576-T (MP-APERS-T) is a different variation of the APERS concept but instead of buckshot it fires flechettes approximately 2 inches long. This design ultimately lead to the M1001 in 40x53mm. The flechettes increase armor penetration and number of projectiles, however each projectile does less damage.

ammo.name: 40mm VOG-25 RD
ammo.description: The 40mm VOG-25 RD is a standard VOG-25 Grenade with a shorter distance fuse. Useful for tight battles, but be careful!

ammo.name: 40x46mm M406 RD
ammo.description: The 40x46mm M406 RD is an M406 with a reduced distance fuse.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Power-Shok #4 Buckshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok #4 Buckshot shell fires 27 #4 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 21 grains (1.33g) and is 6.1mm in diameter. These Shells are ideal for close range against little armor.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok #4 Buckshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok #4 Buckshot shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Power-Shok #1 Buckshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok #1 Buckshot shell fires 16 #1 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 41 grains (2.62g) and is 7.62mm in diameter. These Shells are ideal for close range against little armor.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok #1 Buckshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok #1 Buckshot shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok BB Birdshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok BB Birdshot shell fires 81 BB lead birdshot pellets at 1500 fps. Each pellet weighs 54 grains (3.49g) and is 6762mm in diameter. These Shells are ideal for close-mid range against little armor.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok BB Birdshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok BB Birdshot shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Power-Shok 00 Buckshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok 00 Buckshot shell fires 9 00 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 41 grains (3.49g) and is 8.38mm in diameter. These Shells are ideal for close-mid range against little armor.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok 00 Buckshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok 00 Buckshot shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Steel Fragmentation Slug
ammo.description:
The 12/70 Steel Fragmentation Slug is a discarding Sabot 32 Gram Steel Fragmentation Slug sold by Firequest. The whole Slug travels at 1,500 fps and on contact, the center slug releases 6 razor sharp steel petals. The steel center core continues to penetrate deep into soft targets, while the petals flower out and enhance the wound channels. It is much less accurate however. 
This ultimately is a close-mid range slug intended for gritty combat, it is not a head-tapper.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Steel Fragmentation Slug
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Steel Fragmentation Slug shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Freight Train Copper Slug
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Freight Train Copper Slug is a hunting sabot slug. It features a streamlined copper projectile and sabot design that can print groups of less than 4 inches at 200 yards. A polymer tip and aerodynamic nose profile maximize downrange energy, while the nose cavity provides dramatic expansion upon impact.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Freight Train Copper Slugs
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Freight Train Copper Slug shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Force X2 Fragmenting 00 Buckshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Force X2 Fragmenting 00 Buckshot is a copper-antimony alloy with a lead interior. Each pellet features a deep cut with striations that open the pellet up upon contact with a soft target. The resulting expansion is rapid and destructive. This limits penetration within the target, however the copper-antimony alloy allow it to still penetrate minor barriers like car doors, windows, and light soft body armor. To top things off, it is a lower recoil round, with an accurate wad design and low heat generation. A truly unique and dangerous round, limited only by its availability and price.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Force X2 Fragmenting 00 Buckshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Force X2 Fragmenting 00 Buckshot shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok #2 Birdshot
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok #2 Birdshot shell fires 141 #2 lead birdshot pellets at 1500 fps. Each pellet weighs 4.38 grains (0.28g) and is 3.81mm in diameter. These Shells are mainly for hunting, however have found their way into the shotguns of tarkov out of necessity.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok #2 Birdshot
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok #2 Birdshot shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Shoulder-Shok 00000 Super Buck
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Shoulder-Shok 00000 Super Buck shell is the result of backcountry tinkering with shotgun shell loads. A standard Federal BB birdshot load is disassembled and the lead shot from it and other scrap lead is melted into .490 lead musket ball molds. Four .490 musket balls can, just barely, fit inside a 12/70 shell with a little wadding. The result is a heavy shell with four large "buckshot" pellets so big they might as well start with an F. Not the most combat effective shell, but when put in the right situation it is brutal. Also good for hunting. (Not a real Federal shell, Named Federal for Organization of Shells in Flea)

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Shoulder-Shok 00000 Super Buck
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Shoulder-Shok 00000 Super Buck Shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 TSS AP Flechette
ammo.description: The 12/70 TSS AP Flechette Shell fires 15 tightly packed Tungsten-Steel Alloy penetrators at supersonic speeds. The result is a more penetrating and accurate shell over the standard Flechette. The density of Tungsten allows small Flechettes and thus more of them.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 TSS AP Flechette
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 TSS AP Flechette Shells.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug is a 547 grain pure lead semi-hollowpoint slug meant for hunting and general shooting. It has a good deal of kick, but is relatively cheap and effective. Really puts the hurt downrange.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slugs
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slugs.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Rifled Slug
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug is a 438 grain (1 oz) pure lead Round nose slug meant for cheap target practice though it can be used hunting. It has less kick than its heavier cousin. It is also incredibly cheap, often bought in bulk for avid shooters. Reliable, low impact on the gun, and effective. What more could you want?

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Rifled Slugs
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Rifled Slugs.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal LE BallistiClean Slug
ammo.description: The 12/70 Federal LE BallistiClean Slug is a 325 grain copper-tin-lead frangible round intended for practice, door breaching, and rare field use. Its compressed powdered metal construction means that impact with a hard surface virtually disintegrates. On soft targets, the hollow point head provides immediate expansion after which the frangible nature of the slug takes over.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12/70 Federal LE BallistiClean Slugs
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12/70 Federal LE BallistiClean Slugs.

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal Double Slug
ammo.description:
The 12/70 Federal Double Slug is a pair of 382 grain copper plated lead slugs meant for hunting and novelty. While not overly successful, the design did garnish the attention of many collectors. Due to the inherent inaccuracy of a dual slug, often only one hits the target unless extremely close. But when both hit, the total weight of lead is greater than 12 pellet 00 buckshot shells.
(Not a real Federal shell, Named Federal for Organization of Shells in Flea)

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum 00 Buckshot
ammo.description:
The 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum 00 Buckshot shell is intended for ONLY 3 1/2 inch chambered shotguns. Use in other shotguns may result in injury or death. This shell fires 18 00 buckshot pellets at 1100 fps. Each pellet is copper plated for added penetration and chance of fragmentation. The additional pellets and powder of this magnum loading mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged.

*This shell should only be chambered in pump shotguns equipped to chamber 3 1/2 magnum shells*

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum Steel T Birdshot
ammo.description:
The 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum Steel T Birdshot shell is intended for ONLY 3 1/2 inch chambered shotguns. Use in other shotguns may result in injury or death. 
This shell fires 71 steel T birdshot pellets at 1550 fps. The additional pellets and powder of this magnum loading mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged. While range is better than other birdshot loads, it is still something to consider during engagements.

*This shell should only be chambered in pump shotguns equipped to chamber 3 1/2 magnum shells*

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum Rifled Slug
ammo.description:
The 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum Rifled Slug is intended for ONLY 3 1/2 inch chambered shotguns. Use in other shotguns may result in injury or death. 
This shell fires a 600 grain (1 3/8 oz) lead slug at a staggering 1890 fps. Total muzzle energy is over 4700 ft/lbs, a true shoulder muncher. The additional power of this magnum load mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged.

*This shell should only be chambered in pump shotguns equipped to chamber 3 1/2 magnum shells*

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum .50 BMG Slug
ammo.description:
The 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum .50 BMG Slug is intended for ONLY 3 1/2 inch chambered shotguns. Use in other shotguns may result in injury or death. 
This shell fires a 665 grain .50 BMG projectile pulled from a HP round that failed to fire. The round travels at 1750 fps, making the total muzzle energy over 4800 ft/lbs. The additional power of this magnum load mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged.

Made by Mechanic as an upgrade to the standard makeshift .50 bmg shell, this 3 1/2 inch magnum version is the .50 BMG at home.

*This shell should only be chambered in pump shotguns equipped to chamber 3 1/2 magnum shells*

ammo.name: 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum "AP-35"
ammo.description:
The 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum AP-20 is intended for ONLY 3 1/2 inch chambered shotguns. Use in other shotguns may result in injury or death. 
This shell fires the AP-20 projectile pulled from a round that failed to fire. The round travels at an incredible 2250 fps, making the total muzzle energy over 4900 ft/lbs. Made by Mechanic as an upgrade to the standard AP-20 shell, this brutal load is intended for only the sturdiest of shotguns, and shoulders.
The additional power of this magnum load mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged.

*This shell should only be chambered in pump shotguns equipped to chamber 3 1/2 magnum shells*

ammo.name: 7.62x51mm Ball 11 Long Range
ammo.description:
The 7.62x51mm Ball 11 Long Range round is a high precision full metal jacket military cartridge designed for marksman rifles, machine guns, and sniper rifles.
*Can only be used in Bolt Action Rifles*

ammoBox.description: A Box of 7.62x51mm Ball 11 Long Range rounds.

ammo.name: 7.62x54mm R Tungsten Carbide AP
ammo.description:
The 7.62x54mm R Tungsten Carbide AP round is a high-power armor-piercing precision cartridge designed for sniper rifles.
*Can only be used in Bolt Action Rifles*

ammoBox.name: Box of 7.62x54mm R Tungsten Carbide AP
ammoBox.description: A Box of 7.62x54mm R Tungsten Carbide AP rounds.

ammo.name: 12.7x55mm PS12 Supersonic
ammo.description: The 12.7x55mm PS12 Supersonic is a standard PS12 round with added gunpowder. This means this round is no longer subsonic, and is therefore much louder, however its penetration increases substantially.

ammoBox.name: Box of 12.7x55mm PS12 Supersonic
ammoBox.description: A Box of 12.7x55mm PS12 Supersonic rounds.

ammo.name: .338 Lapua Magnum Fr HP
ammo.description: The .338 Lapua Magnum Fr HP is a copper-tin frangible round intended for target practice without destroying steel target. Designed to mimic the flight path of similar hunting rounds, it should impact where expected. Like its closely related .50bmg round, it can dump all of immense energy in a single gel block.

ammo.name: 6.5x25mm CBJ APDS
ammo.description:
The 6.5x25mm CBJ APDS is part of the 6.5 CBJ family. This particular cartridge is capable of incredible armor penetration. It features a 4mm pure tungsten penetrator surrounded by a 6.5mm sabot. It can penetrate 9mm of hardened steel armor from a carbine barrel, and about 7.5mm of armor from a pistol length barrel.

6.5 CBJ is a new cartridge takes up the same dimensions as 9mm, but features a necked down casing, similar to .357 SIG, but from 9mm to 6.5mm. This enables much higher velocities and exceptional armor piercing. 

*This cartridge depends on a new barrel, which has only been made for a very few weapons. Due to game constraints, this means that this round will only chamber in Glocks, MP5, or MP9 weapon systems. It will fit in all 9mm magazines, but will only work in those platforms.*

Its purpose is for law enforcement to have a poor ballistic coefficient, limiting its range and chance for third party injuries during shooting events. However, its penetration is still remarkable, able to penetrate a kevlar and titanium target and maintain 12 inches of soft target penetration. Its wound channel is also notable.

ammo.name: 7.62x51mm M14A1
ammo.description: The 7.62x51mm M14A1 round was designed as an Armor Piercing Incendiary (API) round intended for the 7.62 NATO platforms. It features a 148 grain projectile with about 7-8 grains of incendiary powder in front of a steel penetrator.

ammo.name: 7.62x54mm R ZBZ3
ammo.description: The 7.62x54mm R ZBZ3 is a soviet and russian designed Armor Piercing Incendiary (API) round intended for the SVD/SVDS platforms. It features a 151 grain projectile with about 9-11 grains of incendiary powder in front of a steel penetrator.

grenades.name: Model 4311 Super Flash Bang Grenade
grenades.description: An upgraded Model 7290, the Model 4311 is a powerful distracting explosive device. Produces 180 dB and a powerful light flash. This upgraded model has a more powerful flash, louder bang, and disorients for much longer. It also features a reduced delay over the original, so be careful!

grenades.name: M67 Reduced Delay
grenades.description: The M67 Reduced Delay Fragmentation Hand Grenade is a modified M67 with a much shorter fuse and slightly more explosive power. While not as short as the vog-25, the reduced fuse time and large explosive radius and shrapnel count makes this grenade particularly devastating.

grenades.name: RGB-9 Enhanced Hand Grenade
grenades.description: The RGB-9 is a modified version of the dependable RGD-5 grenade. The fuse body was shortened and replaced with additional fragments. The fragments are also slightly larger in size and made of denser metal. This combination makes the grenade much more deadly for anyone in its radius. As a tradeoff, it is much heavier, harder to throw, more expensive, and has a slightly smaller blast radius.

properties.Description: РГД-5 (Ручная Граната Дистанционная, модификация 5) относится к противопехотным осколочным ручным гранатам дистанционного действия наступательного типа. Время замедления запала 3,2—4,2 секунды. Так как граната наступательного типа осколки гранаты имеют небольшую массу и соответственно летят на меньшую дальность.
properties.Name: Граната РГД-5

grenades.name: VOG-21 Disruption Grenade
grenades.description: The VOG-21 Disruption Grenade utilizes the same body as the standard VOG-17, but with some of the explosive power being traded for a small flash grenade. The result is a grenade that will disrupt the enemy through direct damage if within the blast radius, or by stunning them with the flash and sound.
